<!--
THE SMALLEST PAGE: a panel with a text field and a slider, and a chart that
redraws when either changes. Copy this file to start a new page.

Everything named VM.* and every ojs-* class comes from the mathviz extension
in _extensions/ -- nothing to load. The guide walks through this page cell by
cell: https://apurvanakade.github.io/mathviz/docs/first-chart.html
-->

Type a function, drag the frequency, toggle the theme in the navbar, press ▶ on the slider.

```{ojs}
VM = window.VM
```

```{ojs}
// The theme pair. Every page has these two lines: any cell that reads
// chartColors re-runs on a light/dark toggle, which is what recolors traces.
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
```

::: {.ojs-panel .ojs-row}
```{ojs}
viewof fText = Inputs.text({label: "f(x)", value: "sin(x) + x/3"})
```
```{ojs}
viewof k = Inputs.range([1, 5], {label: "Frequency", step: 0.1, value: 1})
```
:::

::: {.ojs-chart-block}
```{ojs}
mainPlot = {
  // null if the text won't parse -- never throws.
  const f = VM.expressions.makeFunction(math, fText)
  const xs = [], ys = []
  for (let i = 0; i <= 400; i++) {
    const x = -6 + 12 * i / 400
    xs.push(x)
    ys.push(f ? f(k * x) : NaN)
  }
  const div = document.createElement("div")
  div.className = "plotly-box-large"
  Plotly.newPlot(div, [
    {x: xs, y: ys, mode: "lines", name: fText, line: {color: chartColors.fn, width: 2.5}, showlegend: false}
  ], VM.plotting.layout({
    xaxis: {title: "x"},
    yaxis: {title: "f(kx)"},
    annotations: f ? [] : VM.plotting.emptyState("Couldn't parse that expression")
  }), VM.plotting.config())
  VM.plotting.autoResize(div)
  return div
}
```
:::
